name: Mailshake
description: Mailshake is a sales-engagement platform for cold-email campaigns, automated sequences, lead management, personalization, deliverability, mail-account workflows, and performance reporting.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned dedicated team API key and one exact positive numeric campaign ID. Agents may read only the bound campaign's privacy-redacted title, creation time, archive/pause flags, and aggregate message count. Relay excludes sender identity, mailboxes, recipients, leads, email addresses, message content/activity, campaign mutations, webhooks, team administration, raw APIs, polling, bulk work, CSV downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read campaign status
capabilities.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured Mailshake campaign ID.

approvalRequired.label: Read campaign status
approvalRequired.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured Mailshake campaign ID.

blocked.label: Change campaigns
blocked.description: Creating, pausing, unpausing, archiving, scheduling, sequencing, changing senders, or otherwise mutating campaigns is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access people or messages
blocked.description: Recipients, leads, contacts, email addresses, sent mail, opens, clicks, replies, unsubscribes, inbox workflows, and other person-level or communication data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private campaign content
blocked.description: Message subjects or bodies, sequence details, sender identity, connected mailboxes, campaign URLs, text replacements, problems, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Access team or automation surfaces
blocked.description: Team members, senders, webhooks/push subscriptions, integrations, OAuth administration, API keys, imports, and recipient or lead automation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, SDK, arbitrary endpoints, list/search/filter queries, pagination, polling, bulk work, asynchronous jobs, exports, CSV downloads, and crawling are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private campaign status read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected status read runs without Relay approval while exact campaign binding, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; people, messaging, campaign writes, and exports stay blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated campaign status read and keeps the API key encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Mailshake account, active paid subscription, dedicated team API key, exact preconfigured campaign ID, API quota, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task create a dedicated team API key, choose one preconfigured campaign, record its exact numeric ID, store both through Relay, then validate Basic authentication, campaign binding, privacy redaction, approval/denial, quota errors, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without pausing, unpausing, changing, or sending from the campaign.

evidence.supports: Official API reference documents the fixed 2017-04-01 origin, customer team API-key Basic authentication, manually approved OAuth for cross-team apps, campaign get, broad people/messaging/mutation/export surfaces, safe error codes, and quota units.

Official campaign get reference documents campaigns/get with a required numeric campaignID and a Campaign response containing title, creation time, archive/pause flags, private message sequence, sender identity, and URL.
Official help documents plan-dependent hourly quota units, monthly recipient limits, and API-key creation under Integrations > API.
Official privacy policy explains Mailshake's access to connected email accounts for sending, replies, bounces, unsubscribes, and lead workflows, reinforcing V1 exclusion of those surfaces.
